reading.title: The Spring Show
reading.purpose: Follow a town as everyone helps put on a show.
paras: Our town had a spring show. A builder made the stage. A painter painted the sign. A writer wrote the story.
A singer sang the song. A dancer spun across the stage. A farmer brought apples for the crowd. Everyone helped, and the show was fun!

qs.q: A farmer grows food. What did the farmer bring?
qs.why: The reading says a farmer brought apples for the crowd.
The reading says a painter painted the sign.
A dancer is a person who moves to music, and the dancer spun across the stage.

reading.retellFrame: In the show, a ___ made the stage and a ___ sang.
